items.blurb: The classic uniform shirt: 65/35 poly-cotton twill with two button-flap chest pockets, a pencil stall, stain release and moisture wicking. Built for daily wear and industrial laundering.

items.name: Short-Sleeve Work Shirt with MIMIX
items.blurb: Red Kap's MIMIX ripstop work shirt with a 100% polyester performance mesh back panel for ventilation, hex-style button-through pockets and Touchtex durability. Ladies' cut is style SX21.

items.name: Short-Sleeve Woven Crew Shirt
items.blurb: A modern two-tone alternative to the button-front uniform shirt: convertible collar, concealed placket, sleeve utility pocket and ZeroSkratch trim so nothing on the shirt scratches a customer's paint.

items.name: Industrial Short-Sleeve Work Shirt
items.blurb: The workhorse industrial uniform shirt — lined collar with sewn-in stays, two chest pockets, Touchtex colour retention and durable press. Rated for industrial laundering. Ladies' cut is style SP23 (Black and Navy).

items.name: Industrial Long-Sleeve Work Shirt

items.name: Heritage Cotton Twill Cap
